exhibits.title: The rules a foreign brand selling online must plan for

rows: In force since 1 Jan 2024; RM817 m collected in 2025 [MOF LVG 2026]

Drafting to finish in 2026; impact assessment next [Malay Mail Sep 2026]
E-invoicing threshold raised to RM3 m
Firms under RM3 m sales exempt
A new entrant's first year is below the line
